data.name: Ashabun
data.gender_notes: Ashabun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ashabun is an Arabic name that means 'Friends of Prophet'. This name is derived from the term 'Ashab', which refers to the companions of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who lived during his lifetime and supported him in his mission to spread Islam. This name is a beautiful reminder of the importance of friendship, love, and companionship in our lives, as well as the significance of following the teachings of the Prophet.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ashabun is a spiritually significant name that symbolizes the connection between the individual and the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). It is a reminder of the importance of companionship and following the teachings of the Prophet in order to lead a virtuous and fulfilling life.
data.etymology: Ashabun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friends of Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashabun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
